body.p: Although it is believed that Szunerits (Szunerits, et al., "Sensing using Localised Surface

Plasmon Resonance Sensors," ChemComm., 48(72):8999-9010, 2012) does not teach or suggest that "at least one particle immobilized relative to the end portion of the end portion," and it is submitted that the Patent Office's interpretation of "relative to" in this phrase is so broad that it effectively has been deleted from the claims, in this Response, claim 1 has been amended to recite "attend to the end portion," as was suggested by the Examiner, thereby mooting these issues. It is not seen where either Szunerits or Rylander, et al., U.S. Pat. Apl. Pub. No. 2013/0338627 teaches or suggests at least one particle attached to the end portion of the member, and nowhere does the Advisory Action identify where such a teaching can be found in either reference, even under the unduly broad construction of "at least one particle immobilized relative to the end portion of the member." Accordingly, it is believed that the claims as pending herein are patentable over the combination of Rylander and Szunerits.

In view of the foregoing remarks, this application should now be in condition for allowance. A notice to this effect is respectfully requested. If the Examiner believes, after the foregoing remarks, that the application is not in condition for allowance, the Examiner is requested to call the undersigned at 617-646-8000.

If this response is not considered timely filed and if a suitable request for an extension of time is otherwise absent, any necessary extension of time is hereby requested. If there is a fee occasioned by this response, including an extension fee, the Director is hereby authorized to charge any deficiency or credit any overpayment in the fees filed, asserted to be filed or which should have been filed herewith to Deposit Account No. 23/2825, under Docket No. H0498.70497US01, from which the undersigned is authorized to draw.
